description: This file is a PHP script responsible for displaying a list view of email records within a customer relationship management (CRM) system, specifically VtigerCRM. It handles retrieving email data from the database, managing sorting, filtering, custom views, pagination, and rendering the list view template.

classes.name: Emails
classes.description: A class representing the emails, instantiated as the focus for list operations.

classes.name: CustomView
classes.description: Handles custom view configurations for filtering email listings.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Custom Smarty template class used for rendering views.

methods.name: initSortbyField
methods.description: Initializes the sorting fields for the Emails list view.

methods.name: getViewId
methods.description: Retrieves the current view ID for the Emails module.

methods.name: getCustomViewCombo
methods.description: Returns HTML for custom view selection dropdown.

methods.name: getCustomViewByCvid
methods.description: Provides description details for a specific custom view.
